text.en: Pet owners consistently praise the staff at Wag 'N Bone, singling out team members Mikayla, Riley, Tonie, and Leslie for their warm reception. Clients feel welcomed from the moment they arrive, noting that groomers listen carefully to styling preferences and maintain a cheerful attitude.

title.en: Accurate breed styling and neat trims

text.en: Reviewers are pleased with the grooming results, specifically highlighting precise scissor trims for Bichon Frises and Pomeranians alongside tidy nail maintenance. Owners report that their dogs leave looking well groomed and smelling clean, with cuts matching their exact instructions.

Clients note the loving care and patience shown towards pets of all ages, including puppies attending their first groom and older, sensitive dogs. Reviewers emphasize that the groomers work calmly and gently, ensuring that dogs remain relaxed and excited to return for future appointments.

q.en: Does Wag 'N Bone offer daycare in addition to dog grooming?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently utilize the facility for both dog daycare and grooming services such as baths and nail trims.

q.en: Can puppies attend their first grooming session here?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report bringing young puppies for introductory grooms, praising the staff for gentle and loving handling.

q.en: Do the groomers cater to breed-specific cuts?

a.en: Clients mention styling for specific breeds including Pomeranians and Bichon Frises, matching owner expectations.

q.en: How are older or sensitive dogs accommodated?

a.en: Reviewers note that groomers treat senior pets with extra gentleness and patience, ensuring a comfortable visit without unnecessary stress.
